issues.description: Method Lecture.toString(): The problem statement (lines 36-38) and the template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 10) expect a custom toString() that returns a String and thus properly overrides Object.toString(). The solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java lines 63-64) declares the method as 'public Object toString()' while also using @Override. Declaring a broader return type (Object) does not correctly override Object.toString() (which returns String) and with the @Override annotation this causes a compilation error, blocking students from compiling or running the provided solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution implementation change the toString() method signature to return String: 'public String toString() { ... }' (keeping the same body) so it properly overrides Object.toString(), matches the problem/template expectation, and compiles without error.
